title: The Second Book
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secretes of the Reuerende Maister Alexis of Piemount
summary: Perfumery: sweet waters; oils of orange, jasmine, nutmeg, benzoin and storax; scented powders for chests and coffers; musked soaps, pomanders and hippocras; perfumes for chambers, lamps and gloves; and powders to clean the teeth.
